title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain University of Portland
description: Ten under-21-safe food destinations with current, source-listed late availability in North Portland or elsewhere in Portland.

cards.title: Taco Bell on N Lombard
cards.subtitle: 4909 N Lombard St, Portland
cards.notes: Use the N Lombard drive-thru when you need a food stop after evening plans; confirm holiday changes before setting out.
cards.short_summary: A North Portland drive-thru listed through 3 a.m. daily.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell’s official location page lists its 4909 N Lombard St drive-thru as open until 3:00 a.m. every day.
cards.access_notes: Official page lists drive-thru hours of 3:00 a.m. daily; dine-in hours are earlier. Holiday hours may vary.

cards.title: Taco Bell on N Interstate
cards.subtitle: 4616 N Interstate Ave, Portland
cards.notes: Choose this N Interstate location for a late drive-thru food option, and check the location page again if visiting on a holiday.
cards.short_summary: A nearby Taco Bell location listed open until 4 a.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell’s official Portland location directory lists the 4616 N Interstate Ave restaurant as open until 4:00 a.m.
cards.access_notes: Official directory lists this location as open until 4:00 a.m.; verify service mode and holiday changes with the restaurant.

cards.title: Taco Bell at Jantzen Beach
cards.subtitle: 12237 N Jantzen Dr, Portland
cards.notes: If you are already headed toward Jantzen Beach, this is a late drive-thru option; review the location page before departure.
cards.short_summary: A Jantzen Beach Taco Bell listed open until 3 a.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell’s official Portland location directory lists 12237 N Jantzen Dr as open until 3:00 a.m.
cards.access_notes: Official directory lists this location as open until 3:00 a.m.; confirm current drive-thru availability and holiday hours.

cards.title: Domino's at 4908 N Lombard
cards.subtitle: 4908 N Lombard St, Portland
cards.notes: Place a carryout or delivery order from the North Lombard store when its posted midnight closing fits your evening schedule.
cards.short_summary: A North Lombard pizza location currently shown open until midnight.
cards.evidence_claim: Domino’s official page for 4908 N Lombard St identifies the Portland store and shows it open until 12:00 a.m.
cards.access_notes: Official store page currently displays “Open Today Until 12:00 AM”; Domino’s says store hours vary by location.

cards.title: Domino's at 8040 N Lombard
cards.subtitle: 8040 N Lombard St, Portland
cards.notes: Use the farther-west Lombard store as a carryout or delivery option, checking the store’s live hours before you order.
cards.short_summary: A second North Lombard pizza stop with location-specific hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Domino’s official page identifies its 8040 N Lombard St Portland store and directs visitors to its Hours section for current store hours.
cards.access_notes: Official page identifies the 8040 N Lombard store and states that location hours vary; it currently lists the store among locations open until midnight.

cards.title: Pizza Hut on N Lombard
cards.subtitle: 5265 N Lombard St, Portland
cards.notes: Order carryout or delivery from this N Lombard location when the posted 1 a.m. schedule works; check for changes first.
cards.short_summary: A N Lombard pizza stop with 1 a.m. hours listed every day.
cards.evidence_claim: Pizza Hut’s official page lists both delivery and carryout at 5265 N Lombard St from 9:00 a.m. to 1:00 a.m. daily.
cards.access_notes: Official page lists delivery and carryout through 1:00 a.m. daily, while noting that delivery hours may vary.

cards.title: Wendy's on N Lombard
cards.subtitle: 1405 N Lombard, Portland
cards.notes: Keep this N Lombard restaurant in mind for an evening food stop; its official schedule lists both restaurant and drive-thru service to midnight.
cards.short_summary: A North Lombard restaurant and drive-thru open until midnight daily.
cards.evidence_claim: Wendy’s official location page lists restaurant and drive-thru hours at 1405 N Lombard as 6:30 a.m.–12:00 a.m. every day.
cards.access_notes: Official page lists restaurant and drive-thru service through 12:00 a.m. daily; holiday hours may vary.

cards.title: Fino in Kenton
cards.subtitle: 8225 N Denver Ave, Portland
cards.notes: Plan a Friday or Saturday dinner in Kenton when a later sit-down meal fits; call ahead or use the official takeout link.
cards.short_summary: A Kenton pasta-and-pizza restaurant with 10 p.m. weekend dinner hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Fino’s official site lists dinner until 10:00 p.m. on Fridays and Saturdays at 8225 N Denver Ave.
cards.access_notes: Official site lists Friday–Saturday dinner from 4:00–10:00 p.m.; Sunday–Thursday dinner ends at 9:00 p.m.

cards.title: Janken in the Pearl District
cards.subtitle: 250 NW 13th Ave, Portland
cards.notes: For a later Portland dinner, reserve or confirm service directly with Janken before making the trip from campus.
cards.short_summary: A Pearl District restaurant whose official hours run to 11 p.m. Friday and Saturday.
cards.evidence_claim: Janken’s official site lists hours until 11:00 p.m. on Fridays and Saturdays at 250 NW 13th Ave.
cards.access_notes: Official site lists Friday and Saturday hours of 5:00–11:00 p.m.; Tuesday–Thursday and Sunday service ends at 10:00 p.m.

cards.title: Xport Rooftop Lounge
cards.subtitle: 1355 SW 2nd Ave, Portland
cards.notes: Check the restaurant’s current service policy and make a reservation if needed before planning a late dinner in downtown Portland.
cards.short_summary: A downtown restaurant location whose official page lists 11 p.m. closing daily.
cards.evidence_claim: Xport’s official contact page lists its 1355 SW 2nd Ave Portland location open from 5:00–11:00 p.m. every day.
cards.access_notes: Official contact page lists hours of 5:00–11:00 p.m. Monday through Sunday; reservations are available through the site.
